contradicting_evidence: Strong current participation across the observed capitalization buckets could develop into a more coherent upward trend than the mixed base case.
Positive 30d altcoin-relative performance and expanding stablecoin supply support continuation as a credible alternative.
Conversely, ETH ETF outflow and weak hourly ETH/BTC could precede a broader downside retest rather than two-sided consolidation.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Two-sided consolidation with intermittent altcoin strength is the base case. Initial strength may persist selectively without becoming a synchronized market advance.
falsification_conditions: Repeated synchronized BTC/ETH gains, firmer ETH/BTC, resilient bucket medians and sustained spot buying would invalidate the mixed outlook toward UP.
Repeated joint price declines, seller-led spot activity and widespread deterioration in the same breadth universe would invalidate it toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: A consecutive multi-day breadth and price sequence demonstrating pullback resistance.
ETH/BTC stabilization beyond one hourly observation and an unchanged packet-to-packet level.
Additional settled ETF sessions showing whether the BTC/ETH flow divergence persists.
Evidence of deployed liquidity rather than stablecoin supply growth alone.
supporting_evidence: Positive current altcoin medians and widespread outperformance of BTC support selective follow-through, but only as contemporaneous proxy evidence.
The latest settled BTC inflow and ETH outflow show uneven capital support, consistent with asset-level divergence.
ETH outperformed BTC over 24h but underperformed slightly in the latest hour, leaving its relative-strength path unresolved.
Neutral sentiment and modest hourly price/open-interest changes do not establish either a strong continuation regime or confirmed distribution.
